status_detail: The five-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4: the ScoreProtoModel penalty walk (exact 0 / slot-0 hole 16 / duplication 20 / mixed 56 / 25-mismatch 500 / output 0), ParamListMerged::foldIn (empty-union adoption, subsume-with-matching-minsize replacement, fully-subsumed no-op, different-stacks refusal, finalize resolver characterization + slot pass-back), ProtoModelMerged::foldIn (first-fold adoption of extrapop/effects/trash, extrapop demotion to extrapop_unknown, inject-id refusal, effect identity + trash intersection, numModels staying 0 across folds — modellist is decode's append), and selectModel (strict-< first-best over the staged constituents, no-active-trials default, score-500 'No model matches : missing default'). Overall remains UNTESTED because the join-piece resolver windows, real cspec-loaded models, the ProtoStoreSymbol/ParameterSymbol store family, and the FuncCallSpecs call-site family are not exercised by this fixture.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-fspec-score-merged-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.spaces: ram=3 (little-endian processor space), stack=6 (8-byte spacebase on ram); constant/other/unique defaults
architecture.space_construction: FixtureArchitecture (minimal concrete Architecture with all pure virtuals stubbed) with AddrSpace 'ram' and SpacebaseSpace 'stack' inserted on the architecture itself; FixtureTranslate only satisfies the space constructors' Translate* bookkeeping. startDecompilerLibrary(empty) registers the print-language capability the Architecture base constructor builds.

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; staged ParamEntry resources via the C++ class->struct field hack (Rugra: parse_pentry builders). Input lists carry two unflagged exclusion entries g0@0x100(8,8) and g1@0x200(8,8); output lists one exclusion entry g0@0x300(8,1); the merged fold cases stage (8,4)/(16,4)/(8,4) entry triples and one stack-based list (8B@0x20, align 8, spacebase=stack).
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built models m1/m2/m3 with extrapop 0/8/0, injectUponEntry -1/-1/5, likelytrash sharing 0x500 and differing at 0x800/0x900/0x800, and identical three-record effect lists (unaffected 0x500, killedbycall 0x600, return_address 0x700, register-space 8B records sorted by address).

analysis_options.model_state: two-entry and three-entry exclusion models with populateResolver run on every staged list (the fspec.cc:1504 configured state; 12.0.4 findEntry consults the resolver)
analysis_options.normalization: None. Raw scores, mismatch counts, entry sizes/groups, containment codes, slot numbers, model names, and LowlevelError explain strings printed verbatim.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; refusals are the oracle's own LowlevelError paths (different stacks / different inject ids / No model matches)

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: ScoreProtoModel(true, m1, n) over the two-entry input model; one output-side scorer over the staged output list (populateResolver included)
cases.expect: exact=0; hole at slot 0 scores penalty[0]=16; duplicated slot scores 20; hole+dup+miss = 16+20+20 = 56; 25 unknown-address parameters reach exactly 500 (the selectModel threshold); the output hit scores 0

cases.setup: ParamListMerged over staged lists a=[(g0,0x100,8,4)], b=[(g0,0x100,16,4),(g1,0x200,8,4)], stackList=[stack 8B@0x20 align 8]
cases.expect: empty union adopts a verbatim (size 1, base 0x100); b's first entry subsumes a's with matching minsize so it replaces in place (size 2, front 16B, back group 1); re-folding a is fully subsumed (size stays 2); the stack-backed list refuses ('Cannot merge prototype models with different stacks'); finalize leaves characterize codes 2/2/0 and slot pass-back (1, slot=1, slotsize=1)

cases.setup: ProtoModelMerged(&arch) folding m1 then m2 (extrapop 0 vs 8, trash 0x800 vs 0x900) then m3 (injectUponEntry 5)
cases.expect: first fold adopts extrapop 0 with 3 effects and 2 trash; second fold demotes extrapop to extrapop_unknown (0x8000), keeps the identical 3 effects, and intersects trash to 1; m3 refuses ('Cannot merge prototype models with different inject ids'); numModels stays 0 across folds (modellist is decode's append, fspec.cc:2918) and 2 after the fixture performs decode's push

cases.setup: staged modellist [m1, m2]; three ParamActive trial sets
cases.expect: a single active slot-1 trial selects m1 (identical input lists, strict-< keeps the first); no active trials scores 0 and also selects m1; 25 active unknown-address trials score 500 which is not < 500, so selectModel throws 'No model matches : missing default'

observation_schema: oracle-result-v1 (pending ORACLE-RESULT-0001; stdout rows are the interim observation record)

decisive_semantics.reference_parameters: foldIn takes const references and copies entry lists; selectModel takes ParamActive* and reads trials without mutation
decisive_semantics.iteration_order: doScore sorts PEntry by slot (stable for equal slots); selectModel walks modellist in order and keeps the FIRST strict-better model, early-exiting at score 0
decisive_semantics.counters: ScoreProtoModel.mismatch increments once per non-parameter address; finalscore = basescore + 20*mismatch; nextfree advances by p.size on continuation, max(p.slot+p.size, nextfree) on duplication
decisive_semantics.comparison_keys: PEntry orders by slot alone; EffectRecord equality is (space,offset,size,type); VarnodeData order is (space index, offset, size descending); the extrapop demotion compares raw ints; the inject refusal compares both inject ids
